description: This PHP class defines a client for interacting with the AWS 'cleanrooms-ml' service. It extends the AwsealAwsClient class and includes method annotations for various API operations related to the cleanrooms-ml service, such as creating, deleting, retrieving, and listing models, datasets, and jobs.

classes.name: CleanRoomsMLClient
classes.description: Client class for interacting with AWS cleanrooms-ml service.

methods.name: createConfiguredModelAlgorithm
methods.description: Creates a new configured model algorithm.

methods.name: deleteConfiguredAudienceModelPolicy
methods.description: Deletes a configured audience model policy.

methods.name: deleteConfiguredModelAlgorithmAssociation
methods.description: Deletes a configured model algorithm association.

methods.name: getCollaborationConfiguredModelAlgorithmAssociation
methods.description: Gets a collaboration configured model algorithm association.

methods.name: getConfiguredAudienceModelPolicy
methods.description: Retrieves a configured audience model policy.

methods.name: getTrainedModelInferenceJob
methods.description: Gets an inference job for a trained model.

methods.name: listCollaborationConfiguredModelAlgorithmAssociations
methods.description: Lists configured model algorithm associations for collaboration.

methods.name: listTrainedModelInferenceJobs
methods.description: Lists inference jobs for trained models.

methods.name: putConfiguredAudienceModelPolicy
methods.description: Sets a policy for a configured audience model.

methods.name: putMLConfiguration
methods.description: Creates or updates an ML configuration.

methods.name: startTrainedModelExportJob
methods.description: Starts an export job for a trained model.

methods.name: startTrainedModelInferenceJob
methods.description: Starts an inference job for a trained model.
